title: perf-canary: add automated latency/throughput regression detector + rollout guard hysteresis
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: We need continuous detection of latency and throughput regressions for model serving canaries and a rollout guard that prevents automatic promotion when regressions are detected. This PR implements an automated detector in the perf-canary service, adds hysteresis to rollout guards to avoid flapping, and wires the decision into the deployment controller. Motivation: recent incidents where small infra changes caused 5-10% tail-latency regressions that slipped through canary windows. The detector runs lightweight statistical checks (median, P95, P99 deltas plus throughput drop) and supports configurable thresholds and evaluation windows. Approach: - Add a detector pipeline that compares current canary window metrics against baseline (rolling baseline from previous stable window) using bootstrap + EWMA smoothing. - Implement hysteresis counters on the rollout guard: a metric must exceed threshold for N consecutive evaluation windows before block is asserted; conversely, require M consecutive clean windows to clear. Provides tunable stability vs sensitivity. - Expose new rollout guard config in perf-canary CRD and Console UI (docs updated). - Add end-to-end tests that run synthetic canaries with injected latency and throughput anomalies to validate detection and gating behavior. Checklist: - [x] Detector implementation (service + API) - [x] Rollout guard hysteresis logic in controller - [x] Config schema + default thresholds - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Dashboard + alert rules - [x] Docs and Linear links Testing notes: local unit tests + integration job passed. Ran a staging canary with synthetic 15% P99 regression; detector flagged and rollout was blocked. Also validated no false positives across 48h stable workload. CI: runs include lint, unit, integration, and perf-regression-smoke tests (all passing in this branch). Follow-ups: - Add adaptive thresholds per model family (ENG-4360) - Add historical anomaly scoring for on-call triage - Expose detector insights in Console with example traces/links
